prerequisites.detail: APIM sends telemetry to Azure Application Insights; AI Gateway sends it through an OpenTelemetry exporter. The only surface both support is the OTLP endpoint on the Application Insights resource, which is off until someone turns it on. Enable it on the existing resource, or create one with it enabled, then settle the telemetry item on an OpenTelemetry exporter pointed at it. Without that endpoint there is no path at all, and the gateway's own metrics are the only telemetry the migration produces.
